QuestInfo.name: Self Sufficiency
QuestInfo.0: Lan Ming had something to say.
QuestInfo.1: The trainees train their minds by leaving the comforts of society behind. That's pretty sad, so we should at least take care of their clothes. Go get #r#t4009007##k and #r#t4009008##k for Lan Ming so that she can mend her clothes.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta gave Lan Ming a Porcupine Spine so Lan Ming could use it as a needle to sew torn clothes.

0.0: Here in Mu Lung, we teach our trainees to give up their worldly comforts, and learn to survive on their own. As you can imagine, that sort of life comes with a lot of ripped trousers. Can you help me patch some?

yes.0: There are no needles in Mu Lung, so bring me #r15 #t4009007##k and #r15 #t4009008##k items. They'll do the job.

no.0: Look at yourself. You look like a garbage collector.

1.0: Sometime you train so hard that you don't even notice your clothes hanging from you in tatters.

yes.0: Ooh, you brought #t4009007# and #t4009008#! Now I don't have to wear clothes with holes in them for awhile!

default.0: I need #r15 #t4009007##k and #r15 #t4009008##k#r#k items. They're kinda like needles.
